description: The main landing screen upon login, providing a high-level overview of the user's business metrics, active campaigns, and recent AI interactions.

layout_structure.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar (Cod Gray background) containing main navigation.
layout_structure.topbar: Fixed top bar with Breadcrumbs ('Home > Dashboard'), Global Search, Notifications (bell icon), and User Profile Dropdown.

components.title: h1: 'Good morning, sumit!'
components.subtitle: body_secondary: 'Here is what is happening with your campaigns today.'

metrics_overview.description: Row of 4 Data Cards displaying key performance indicators (KPIs).
metrics_overview.layout: Grid (4 columns on desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile). Gap: 24px.

main_charts_row.layout: Grid (2 columns: 2/3 width and 1/3 width). Gap: 24px. Margin-top: 32px.

columns.name: engagement_chart
columns.title: Engagement Overview
columns.content: Line chart showing 'Messages Sent' vs 'Replies Received' over the last 30 days. Smooth curves, primary line in Kournikova, secondary line in French Pass (Sky Blue).

columns.name: recent_activity
columns.title: Recent Activity
columns.content: A vertical list of recent events (e.g., 'Campaign X started', 'New lead captured via AI Voice').

quick_actions.description: A section at the bottom for quick access to frequent tasks.

visual_prompt_notes: For image generation: Show a wide SaaS dashboard. The left sidebar is dark Cod Gray (#1B1B1B) with white text and a yellow (#FFE27C) highlight on the 'Dashboard' menu item. The main area is light (#FAF9F6) with 4 white metric cards at the top. Below them is a clean line chart with smooth lines, and a sidebar for recent activity. Use a modern sans-serif font, rounded corners (8px-12px) for cards, and subtle drop shadows.
